_help: Catálogo de servicios y productos de Devleck. La IA SOLO recomienda lo que esté aquí con active=true. allNiches=true significa que aplica a cualquier nicho. 'salesGuide' es material de aprendizaje para el equipo (en español). Edítalo desde la interfaz (modo administrador) o con /nuevo-servicio en Claude Code, y luego súbelo al repo.

items.name: AI Receptionist & Booking Agent
items.oneLiner: An AI agent that answers calls, chats and web forms 24/7, qualifies the customer and books the appointment directly in the business calendar.
items.description: Omnichannel AI agent (phone, website chat, SMS, WhatsApp, Instagram DM) trained on the business's services, prices and policies. It answers questions, qualifies leads, books/reschedules appointments in the existing calendar/CRM and escalates to a human when needed. Built on Claude, integrated with the tools the business already uses.
deliverables: Voice + chat agent trained on the business
Dashboard with conversations and booked appointments

idealCustomer.companySize: 2–100 employees, appointment-driven, high inbound call volume
idealCustomer.description: Local service businesses that lose money when the phone isn't answered: after-hours calls, busy front desk, slow web-lead response.

buyingSignals: Reviews complaining about not answering the phone, voicemail full or slow replies
Job posts for receptionist / front desk / call center / scheduling coordinator
Website only has a contact form or 'call us' (no online booking, no chat)
Multiple locations or extended hours
Running Google/Facebook ads (paying for leads that may go unanswered)
disqualifiers: Already uses an AI receptionist/chatbot that books appointments
National chain with corporate call center

pricing.notes: Setup único + mensualidad de operación (hosting, minutos de voz, ajustes). Precio fijo por fase.

items.roi: If they miss 10 calls/week and a new customer is worth $300, that's ~$150k/year walking to competitors. The agent pays for itself with 2–3 recovered customers a month.

pitch.hook: Most {niche} lose 1 in 4 calls after hours or when the front desk is busy — we build an AI receptionist that answers every call and books the appointment for you.
valueProps: Never miss a call or a web lead again
Costs less than a part-time receptionist
You own it — no per-seat SaaS
pitch.proof: Built on Claude by a senior engineering team; weekly demos so you see it working before you pay the next phase.

objections.objection: Customers want to talk to a human.
objections.response: Totally — the agent hands off to your team instantly for anything sensitive. It just makes sure nobody hits voicemail at 7 pm and calls your competitor instead.
Great — this isn't replacing her, it's covering lunch, after-hours, weekends and the moments she's on another line. How many calls do you think go to voicemail in a week?
It's a fixed setup, quoted after a free call. If it doesn't recover more than it costs in the first months, it's not worth doing — and we'll tell you that.

salesGuide.simple: Es un 'recepcionista' con IA que contesta el teléfono, el chat de la web, WhatsApp e Instagram 24/7. Responde preguntas, califica al cliente y le agenda la cita directamente en el calendario del negocio. Si algo es delicado, pasa la llamada a una persona.
howItWorks: Reunión inicial: aprendemos servicios, precios, horarios y políticas del negocio.
Configuramos el agente con esa información y lo conectamos a su calendario o CRM.
Lo probamos con llamadas reales en un número de prueba (demo semanal).
Lo activamos: primero fuera de horario y luego cuando la recepción está ocupada.
Cada mes revisamos conversaciones y mejoramos respuestas.
salesGuide.example: Una clínica dental recibe 15 llamadas después de las 6 pm cada semana y todas iban al buzón. Con el agente, esas llamadas se contestan, se agendan 6–8 citas nuevas por semana y la recepcionista llega en la mañana con la agenda llena.
qualifyingQuestions: What happens to calls after hours or when the front desk is busy?
Roughly how many calls go to voicemail in a week?
What is a new customer worth to you on average?
Which calendar or booking system do you use today?
salesGuide.priceTalk: Compáralo con un recepcionista de medio tiempo (USD 1.800–2.500 al mes en EE. UU.). El setup se paga una vez y la mensualidad cuesta menos que una semana de sueldo. Si recupera 2–3 clientes al mes, se paga solo.
redFlags: Ya tienen un chatbot que agenda citas y están contentos.
Casi no reciben llamadas (menos de ~20 a la semana).

glossary.meaning: Sistema donde el negocio guarda sus clientes y oportunidades (ej. HubSpot).
Cuando la IA transfiere la conversación a una persona.

items.name: Back-Office Process Automation
items.oneLiner: We automate the repetitive work — invoicing, data entry, reconciliation, CRM/ERP sync, approvals — so the team stops copying data between systems.
items.description: Custom automations and internal tools that connect the systems a company already uses (QuickBooks, Xero, Salesforce, HubSpot, spreadsheets, ERPs, email) and remove manual steps: invoicing and reconciliation, order/inventory sync, document processing with AI, approval flows with digital signatures, reporting.

idealCustomer.description: Companies whose operations run on spreadsheets, email and double data entry, and whose admin headcount grows with revenue.

buyingSignals: Job posts for data entry, billing specialist, AP/AR clerk, dispatcher, admin assistant
Fast growth (new locations, hiring spree, new contracts) without new systems
Mentions of spreadsheets, paper forms, PDFs, fax or 'email us your documents'
Uses several disconnected tools (QuickBooks + CRM + spreadsheets)
disqualifiers: Fewer than 5 employees with almost no admin work
Has a large in-house IT/dev team
painPointsSolved: Hours lost to manual data entry
Systems that don't talk to each other

pricing.notes: Cada automatización contenida suele estar entre USD 1.500 y 3.500. Mantenimiento mensual opcional.

items.roi: 10 people × 5 hours/week of manual work × $25/hour ≈ $65,000/year and 2,600 hours reclaimed.

pitch.hook: We help {niche} stop paying people to copy data between systems — invoicing, dispatch, reconciliation, reports.
valueProps: Works with the tools you already have
pitch.proof: Free scoping call ends with a written brief and an ROI estimate — you decide with numbers.

objections.objection: We tried Zapier and it broke.
objections.response: That's common — no-code glue breaks at scale. We build it like real software: tested, monitored, documented, and you own it.
That's exactly why off-the-shelf tools fail for you. Custom is our whole business — we map your process first, then automate only what pays back.

salesGuide.simple: Hacemos que las tareas repetitivas de oficina se hagan solas: pasar datos de un sistema a otro, facturar, conciliar pagos, generar reportes, aprobar documentos. El equipo deja de copiar y pegar.
howItWorks: Mapeamos el proceso actual con quien lo hace (1–2 reuniones).
Calculamos horas y dinero que se pierden hoy (estimado de ROI).
Construimos la automatización conectando las herramientas que ya usan.
Probamos con datos reales y dejamos monitoreo y alertas.
Entregamos documentación y capacitamos al equipo.
salesGuide.example: Una empresa de transporte tenía 2 personas pasando comprobantes de entrega a QuickBooks para facturar. Automatizamos la lectura de los comprobantes con IA y la creación de la factura: el proceso pasó de 2 días a minutos.
qualifyingQuestions: Which tasks does your team repeat every day or week?
How many people touch that process and for how long?
Which systems hold the data today (QuickBooks, spreadsheets, CRM)?
What happens when there is a mistake in that process?
salesGuide.priceTalk: Habla de horas recuperadas: 10 personas × 5 horas a la semana × USD 25/hora ≈ USD 65.000 al año. Una automatización de USD 2.000–4.000 se paga en semanas.
redFlags: Empresa de menos de 5 personas con casi nada de trabajo administrativo.
Tienen un equipo grande de TI que ya hace esto.

glossary.meaning: Conectar dos sistemas para que compartan datos automáticamente.
Software que maneja inventario, compras, facturación y contabilidad.

items.name: Custom Web Platform / Customer Portal
items.oneLiner: Fast, modern web platforms, customer portals and internal tools built with Next.js — designed to scale and convert.
items.description: Custom web applications: customer portals (quotes, orders, tracking, documents), booking/ordering platforms, internal dashboards, marketplaces and SaaS MVPs. Built with Next.js/React, Node and PostgreSQL, with design system, SEO and performance included.

idealCustomer.description: Businesses whose customers still request quotes, orders or status updates by phone/email, or startups that need an MVP built by seniors.

buyingSignals: Customers must call or email for quotes, order status or documents
Outdated website (old copyright year, not mobile friendly, slow)
Recent funding round or new product launch
Job posts for a web developer / CTO (we can be the team instead)
disqualifiers: Has a strong in-house product team

pricing.notes: MVP desde ~USD 6.000. Una plataforma completa normalmente entre USD 12.000 y 35.000, dividida en fases.

items.roi: A self-service portal removes most status/quote calls and emails and lets the business sell 24/7.

pitch.hook: We build customer portals that let your clients get quotes, place orders and track status online — without calling your team.
pitch.proof: Next.js/React platforms engineered for real users and real load, not templates.

objections.response: Most of our clients do — the question is whether it does work for you. Can your customers get a quote or check an order without calling you?

objections.objection: We'd rather hire an in-house developer.
objections.response: One mid-level in-house developer costs $100k+/year and takes months to hire. We give you a senior team for a fixed price per phase, and hand over everything documented if you hire later.

salesGuide.simple: Construimos aplicaciones web a la medida: portales donde los clientes cotizan, hacen pedidos y ven el estado de su orden, paneles internos o productos SaaS. No son plantillas: es software propio del cliente.
howItWorks: Descubrimiento: entendemos usuarios, procesos y objetivo de negocio.
Arquitectura y precio fijo por fase.
Construcción con demos semanales en un ambiente real.
Pruebas, seguridad y rendimiento.
Lanzamiento, documentación y entrega del código.
salesGuide.example: Un distribuidor recibía 200 pedidos por correo a la semana. Le construimos un portal donde sus clientes ven precios, hacen pedidos y descargan facturas: los pedidos por correo bajaron a la mitad en dos meses.
qualifyingQuestions: How do customers request quotes or check order status today?
How many of those requests does your team handle per week?
What does your current website do for the business?
Do you have anyone in-house maintaining software?
salesGuide.priceTalk: Divídelo en fases: el MVP resuelve el problema principal y se paga solo antes de invertir en lo demás. Compáralo con contratar un desarrollador en EE. UU. (USD 100.000+ al año).
redFlags: Solo quieren una web informativa de 5 páginas.
Tienen un equipo de producto propio fuerte.

glossary.meaning: Primera versión mínima que ya resuelve el problema principal.
Zona privada donde cada cliente gestiona sus pedidos, documentos y pagos.

items.name: Mobile App (iOS + Android)
items.oneLiner: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps from a single codebase — loyalty, ordering, booking, field-team apps.
items.description: React Native apps for customers (ordering, booking, loyalty, memberships) or for field teams (inspections, deliveries, time tracking, photos, signatures), connected to the company's backend.

idealCustomer.companySize: Multi-location businesses or companies with field teams
idealCustomer.description: Brands with recurring customers who would use an app, or companies with crews in the field using paper or WhatsApp.

buyingSignals: Several locations / franchise growth
Field crews and paper forms
Loyalty/membership model
Competitors already have an app
disqualifiers: Single small location with low repeat customers
painPointsSolved: Dependence on third-party apps and their fees

pricing.notes: App iOS + Android desde un solo código. Primera fase (MVP) desde ~USD 7.000.

items.roi: Owning the ordering/booking channel avoids 15–30% marketplace fees and increases repeat purchases.

pitch.hook: We build the app your customers or your field team actually use — iOS and Android from one codebase, owned by you.
valueProps: You own it — no platform fees
pitch.proof: Weekly builds you can install on your phone and test.

objections.response: Which is why we scope a first phase that pays back on its own — usually ordering or booking — before anything else.

salesGuide.simple: Apps para iPhone y Android hechas con un solo código: apps para clientes (pedidos, reservas, membresías, fidelización) o para equipos de campo (inspecciones, entregas, fotos, firmas).
howItWorks: Definimos la funcionalidad clave de la primera fase.
Diseñamos las pantallas y el flujo.
Construimos app + backend + panel de administración.
Cada semana el cliente instala la versión nueva en su teléfono.
Publicamos en App Store y Google Play.
salesGuide.example: Una empresa de techos con 6 cuadrillas usaba papel y WhatsApp para reportes. Con la app, cada cuadrilla sube fotos y firmas desde la obra y la oficina factura el mismo día.
qualifyingQuestions: Who would use the app — customers or your team in the field?
How do they do that today?
Do your competitors already have an app?
How many users would it have in the first year?
salesGuide.priceTalk: Una sola base de código = dos apps por el precio de una. Empezar con la función que genera ingresos (pedidos o reservas) para que la primera fase se pague sola.
redFlags: Negocio de una sola sede con pocos clientes recurrentes.

glossary.meaning: Tecnología para hacer apps iOS y Android con un solo código.

items.name: Website Rebuild — Performance, SEO & Conversion
items.oneLiner: We rebuild slow, outdated websites into fast, SEO-healthy sites that turn visitors into calls and bookings.
items.description: Technical rebuild of the website focused on Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, local SEO structure, conversion (clear CTAs, online booking/quote forms, click-to-call) and analytics. Often the entry point before automation or AI.

idealCustomer.companySize: Any local business with a weak website
idealCustomer.description: Profitable local businesses with a website that looks 2015, loads slowly on mobile or doesn't rank.

buyingSignals: Old copyright year in the footer
Not mobile friendly / very slow
No clear call-to-action or online booking
Strong reviews but weak website (good business, bad online presence)
disqualifiers: Website recently rebuilt by an agency and performing well
painPointsSolved: Losing customers to competitors with better sites
Paying ads that land on a slow page

pricing.notes: Oferta de entrada ideal. Después se vende AI Receptionist o automatización.

items.roi: Faster mobile pages and clear CTAs typically lift calls/bookings from the same traffic.

pitch.hook: I took a look at your website on my phone — {specificIssue}. That usually costs {niche} real calls every week.
valueProps: Built by engineers, not a template shop
Designed to generate calls and bookings
pitch.proof: We can send a short free audit of your current site before the call.

objections.response: No problem — we can send the audit to whoever manages it. The goal is just that the site brings you business.

salesGuide.simple: Rehacemos webs lentas o anticuadas para que carguen rápido en el celular, aparezcan en Google y conviertan visitas en llamadas y reservas.
howItWorks: Auditoría gratis de su web actual (velocidad, SEO, conversión).
Nuevo diseño enfocado en llamadas y reservas.
Construcción rápida y optimizada.
Configuración de analítica para medir llamadas y formularios.
Lanzamiento sin perder su posicionamiento actual.
salesGuide.example: Un taller tenía 4.8 estrellas en Google, pero su web tardaba 9 segundos en cargar en el celular. Con la web nueva (1.5 s y botón de llamar visible) aumentaron las llamadas desde la misma cantidad de visitas.
qualifyingQuestions: How do most new customers find you today?
Do you run Google or Facebook ads to your website?
Who manages the website right now?
How many calls or bookings come from the site per month?
salesGuide.priceTalk: Es nuestra oferta de entrada: precio bajo, resultado visible rápido. Luego ofrecemos AI Receptionist o automatización al mismo cliente.
redFlags: Su web fue rehecha hace poco por una agencia y funciona bien.

glossary.meaning: Métricas de Google que miden qué tan rápida y estable es una web.
Porcentaje de visitantes que llaman, reservan o escriben.

items.name: Private AI Assistant over Company Documents
items.oneLiner: A private ChatGPT-style assistant that answers from the company's own documents, policies, contracts and case files — securely.
items.description: Retrieval-augmented AI (private LLM) over the firm's knowledge: contracts, case files, policies, manuals, SOPs, past proposals. Staff ask questions in plain English and get answers with citations. Deployed in the client's cloud with encryption and access control.

idealCustomer.description: Knowledge-heavy firms where staff spend hours searching documents or re-asking senior people the same questions.

buyingSignals: Large document volume (case files, policies, contracts)
Hiring paralegals / analysts / coordinators
Mentions of compliance or quality manuals
Onboarding many new employees
disqualifiers: Very small firm with few documents
painPointsSolved: Data privacy fears with public AI tools

pricing.notes: Primer caso de uso desde ~USD 3.500. Mensualidad de hosting y mantenimiento.

items.roi: If 20 staff save 3 hours/week searching, that's ~3,000 hours/year.

pitch.hook: We build private AI assistants for {niche} that answer from your own files — with citations — without sending your data to public chatbots.
pitch.proof: We start from one concrete use case and only ship if it beats how your team works today.

objections.response: That's the point of a private deployment — it runs in your environment, encrypted, with permissions. Nothing goes to a public chatbot.

salesGuide.simple: Un 'ChatGPT privado' de la empresa: el equipo le pregunta en lenguaje normal y responde usando los documentos internos (contratos, manuales, expedientes, políticas), indicando la fuente. Los datos no salen de la empresa.
howItWorks: Elegimos un caso de uso concreto (ej. responder preguntas sobre pólizas).
Cargamos e indexamos los documentos de forma segura.
Configuramos el asistente con permisos por usuario.
Medimos si responde mejor y más rápido que el proceso actual.
Lo desplegamos en la nube del cliente con cifrado.
salesGuide.example: Una firma de abogados con 10 años de expedientes: los asociados buscaban precedentes internos durante horas. Con el asistente encuentran el caso y el párrafo exacto en segundos.
qualifyingQuestions: How much time does your team spend searching for information in documents?
Who gets interrupted with the same questions over and over?
Are people already pasting company data into ChatGPT?
Where are the documents stored today?
salesGuide.priceTalk: 20 personas ahorrando 3 horas por semana ≈ 3.000 horas al año. Empieza con un caso de uso pequeño y medible.
redFlags: Empresa muy pequeña con pocos documentos.

glossary.meaning: Técnica donde la IA busca en tus documentos antes de responder.
Modelo de lenguaje (como Claude o GPT) que entiende y redacta texto.

items.name: Retail AI — Demand Forecasting & Dynamic Pricing
items.oneLiner: AI models that forecast demand, optimize inventory and adjust prices so the business stops overstocking and running out.
items.description: Forecasting and repricing models trained on the company's sales history, seasonality and catalog, integrated with their e-commerce/POS/ERP. Includes inventory recommendations and pricing rules with guardrails.

idealCustomer.description: Retailers and distributors with enough sales history and SKUs that inventory mistakes are expensive.

buyingSignals: Large catalog on Shopify/WooCommerce/Amazon
Frequent out-of-stock or clearance sales
Hiring inventory planners / buyers
Multiple warehouses or channels
disqualifiers: Tiny catalog or under ~1 year of sales data

pricing.notes: Fase 1 = auditoría de datos (~USD 1.500–2.500) antes de construir el modelo.

items.roi: A few points less overstock on a $1M inventory frees tens of thousands in cash.

pitch.hook: We build forecasting models for {niche} that tell you what to reorder and when — so less cash sits in the warehouse.
valueProps: Only ships if it beats your current method
pitch.proof: We benchmark against your current forecasting before you commit to the next phase.

objections.response: Everyone's is. Phase one is a data audit — you get a clear answer on whether AI is worth it before building anything.

salesGuide.simple: Modelos de IA que predicen cuánto se va a vender de cada producto para comprar la cantidad correcta y ajustar precios, sin quedarse sin stock ni llenar la bodega.
howItWorks: Auditoría de datos de ventas e inventario.
Construcción del modelo de pronóstico con su historial.
Comparación contra su método actual (solo seguimos si es mejor).
Integración con su tienda online, POS o ERP.
Panel con recomendaciones de compra.
salesGuide.example: Una tienda online con 2.000 productos compraba 'a ojo' y tenía un 20% del inventario parado. El modelo recomienda cantidades por producto y temporada, y se libera caja.
qualifyingQuestions: How do you decide how much to reorder today?
How often do you run out of stock or end up with overstock?
How many products (SKUs) do you sell?
How many years of sales data do you have?
salesGuide.priceTalk: Unos pocos puntos menos de sobreinventario sobre USD 1M en stock liberan decenas de miles en caja. La fase 1 (auditoría) es barata y dice si vale la pena.
redFlags: Pocos productos o menos de un año de historial de ventas.

glossary.meaning: Cada producto o variante distinta que se vende.
Quedarse sin un producto que el cliente quiere comprar.

items.name: AI Jewelry Design Studio (Claude + Blender / AutoCAD)
items.oneLiner: An AI design tool that turns a customer's idea, sketch or photo into a 3D jewelry model and photorealistic render in minutes — integrated with Blender / AutoCAD / Rhino workflows.
items.description: Custom design assistant for jewelers: the customer describes the piece (or uploads a sketch/inspiration photo), Claude generates design variations and parametric 3D models through Blender/AutoCAD scripting, renders photorealistic previews for approval, and exports CAD files ready for casting / 3D printing. Cuts custom-design turnaround from days to minutes and closes more custom orders in the first visit.
deliverables: AI design assistant tuned to the jeweler's style
Export to STL/3DM for casting or printing

idealCustomer.companySize: Independent jewelers and small chains (1–30 employees) that sell custom pieces
idealCustomer.description: Jewelers selling custom engagement rings, wedding bands and bespoke pieces, who depend on a CAD designer (in-house or outsourced) and lose sales while customers wait for renders.

buyingSignals: Offers 'custom design', 'bespoke', 'design your own ring' or engagement ring services
Mentions CAD design, 3D printing or in-house casting
Instagram full of custom pieces / renders
Job posts for CAD jewelry designer
Reviews mentioning design process, waiting for renders or multiple revisions
disqualifiers: Pawn shops / gold buyers without design services
painPointsSolved: Days of waiting for CAD renders
Customers who leave to 'think about it'

pricing.notes: Depende de la integración CAD (Blender, AutoCAD, Rhino) y de cuánto se personaliza al estilo del joyero.

items.roi: Closing just 1–2 extra custom engagement rings a month (avg. $3k–$6k each) pays for the system in the first months.

pitch.hook: We built an AI design tool for jewelers: your customer describes the ring, and in minutes you show them a photorealistic 3D render — while they're still in the store.
valueProps: Close custom orders on the first visit
pitch.proof: We can show a live demo with one of your own pieces as reference.

objections.objection: We already have a CAD designer.
objections.response: Perfect — this makes your designer 5x faster: the AI produces the first variations and renders, your designer refines. Less waiting, more closed sales.
Agreed — it doesn't replace your craft. It shows the customer the idea instantly so they commit; your team still makes the final design.

salesGuide.simple: Herramienta con IA para joyerías: el cliente describe el anillo o muestra una foto o un boceto, y en minutos la joyería le muestra un render 3D fotorrealista y variaciones del diseño. El archivo sale listo para el diseñador CAD o para impresión 3D y fundición.
howItWorks: Entendemos el estilo del joyero y su flujo de diseño actual.
Configuramos Claude para generar diseños con ese estilo.
Conectamos con Blender, AutoCAD o Rhino para generar el modelo 3D.
Creamos renders fotorrealistas para aprobar con el cliente en la tienda.
Exportamos archivos STL/3DM para fundición o impresión.
salesGuide.example: Una pareja entra buscando un anillo de compromiso personalizado. Antes debía esperar 4 días por el render del diseñador CAD y la mitad no volvía. Ahora ve 3 opciones en 3D en la misma visita y deja el anticipo ese día.
qualifyingQuestions: How many custom pieces do you design per month?
Who does your CAD work today — in-house or outsourced?
How long from first visit to approved design?
What share of customers leave to 'think about it'?
salesGuide.priceTalk: Un solo anillo de compromiso a medida vale USD 3.000–6.000. Si cierra 1–2 anillos más al mes, el sistema se paga en los primeros meses.
redFlags: Solo revenden joyería de marca, sin diseño propio.
Casas de empeño o compradores de oro.

glossary.meaning: Diseño asistido por computador: el modelo 3D exacto de la joya.
Imagen fotorrealista generada a partir del modelo 3D.
Formatos de archivo 3D para impresión y fundición.

items.name: Generative Content Pipeline
items.oneLiner: Automated AI pipelines that produce on-brand product descriptions, listings, images and short videos at volume.
items.description: Custom pipelines that generate and publish content at scale: real-estate listing descriptions and virtual staging, e-commerce product copy and images, social posts and short videos — reviewed by humans and kept on brand.

idealCustomer.companySize: Businesses publishing many listings/products every week
idealCustomer.description: Teams that manually write hundreds of listings, product pages or posts.

buyingSignals: Hundreds of listings/products
Hiring content writers / social media coordinators
Inconsistent or missing product descriptions

pricing.notes: Pipeline inicial + mensualidad opcional por volumen de contenido.

items.roi: Turns days of copywriting into minutes per batch.

pitch.hook: We build AI pipelines that write and publish your listings/product pages in your brand voice — your team just approves.
pitch.proof: We can generate a sample batch from your own listings.

objections.response: Generic prompts do. We train it on your best-performing listings and your tone, and a human approves every batch.

salesGuide.simple: Sistemas de IA que producen contenido a escala con la voz de la marca: descripciones de productos o propiedades, imágenes, publicaciones y videos cortos. Una persona aprueba antes de publicar.
howItWorks: Analizamos su mejor contenido y su tono de marca.
Construimos el pipeline de generación entrenado con eso.
Agregamos un paso de aprobación humana.
Conectamos la publicación con su plataforma (Shopify, MLS, redes).
Medimos tiempo ahorrado y rendimiento.
salesGuide.example: Una inmobiliaria publica 80 propiedades al mes y cada descripción tomaba 30 minutos. Ahora se generan en lote con su estilo y el agente solo revisa y aprueba.
qualifyingQuestions: How much content do you publish per week (products, listings, posts)?
Who writes it today and how long does it take?
Is the tone consistent across your team?
Which platforms do you publish to?
salesGuide.priceTalk: Compáralo con el costo de un redactor o diseñador. Convierte días de trabajo en minutos por lote.

glossary.meaning: Cadena automática de pasos: generar, revisar y publicar.

items.name: Reviews & Customer Sentiment Intelligence
items.oneLiner: AI that reads every review, survey and support ticket across locations and tells management exactly what to fix — plus drafted replies.
items.description: Sentiment analysis across Google, Yelp, TripAdvisor, surveys and tickets, by location and topic, with alerts, weekly executive reports and AI-drafted review responses.

idealCustomer.description: Multi-location brands whose reputation drives revenue and who can't read every review.

buyingSignals: Hundreds/thousands of reviews
Unanswered reviews
Mixed ratings across locations

pricing.notes: Setup por número de sedes + mensualidad de monitoreo.

items.roi: Each star of rating has a direct effect on local revenue; fixing the top recurring complaint pays back quickly.

pitch.hook: We give {niche} with several locations one dashboard that reads every review and tells you what to fix first — and drafts the replies.
pitch.proof: We can run a free snapshot on your last 200 reviews.

objections.objection: We already use a reviews tool.
objections.response: Most tools count stars. This tells you why — by topic and location — and what to fix first.

salesGuide.simple: IA que lee todas las reseñas (Google, Yelp, encuestas) de todas las sedes y le dice al dueño qué problema se repite, en qué sede, y qué arreglar primero. Además redacta respuestas a las reseñas con el tono de la marca.
howItWorks: Conectamos las fuentes de reseñas de cada sede.
La IA clasifica temas y sentimiento.
Panel por sede y alertas de reseñas negativas.
Reporte semanal con prioridades.
Borradores de respuesta para aprobar.
salesGuide.example: Un grupo de 5 restaurantes descubrió que el 40% de las reseñas negativas de una sede hablaban del tiempo de espera los fines de semana. Ajustaron personal y la calificación subió.
qualifyingQuestions: How many locations do you have?
Who reads and answers reviews today?
Do you know the top complaint per location?
How many reviews do you get per month?
salesGuide.priceTalk: Cada estrella en Google afecta directamente las ventas locales. Ofrece un análisis gratis de sus últimas 200 reseñas como gancho.
redFlags: Una sola sede con pocas reseñas.

glossary.meaning: La IA detecta si un texto es positivo, negativo o neutral y de qué tema habla.

items.oneLiner: Audit and fix existing software that's slow, insecure or abandoned by the previous developer — in priority order.
items.description: We audit the existing app (security, performance, architecture, data), deliver a prioritized report and then fix the issues — or take over development as an embedded senior team.

idealCustomer.description: Businesses that depend on custom software built by a freelancer or agency that disappeared, or that's slow and breaking.

App store reviews complaining about bugs
Very slow web app
Custom platform with no visible tech team

pitch.hook: If your platform was built by a developer who's no longer around, we audit it, tell you exactly what's risky, and fix it in priority order.

salesGuide.simple: Rescatamos software que ya existe pero está lento, inseguro o abandonado por el desarrollador anterior. Primero auditamos y entregamos un informe claro; luego arreglamos en orden de prioridad o tomamos el desarrollo.
howItWorks: Auditoría de 15 áreas (seguridad, datos, rendimiento, arquitectura...).
Informe con puntaje de 0 a 100 y riesgos explicados en lenguaje de negocio.
Plan de correcciones priorizado con precio por fase.
Correcciones o toma del desarrollo.
Documentación para que no vuelva a pasar.
salesGuide.example: Una startup dependía de una plataforma hecha por un freelancer que desapareció. La auditoría encontró contraseñas expuestas y una base de datos sin respaldos. Se corrigió en 3 semanas antes de que se convirtiera en un incidente.
qualifyingQuestions: Who built your platform and who maintains it today?
Is anything slow, breaking or scary to change?
When was the last security review?
Do you have backups and documentation?
salesGuide.priceTalk: La auditoría es una entrada de bajo riesgo (USD 800–2.000) y dice exactamente qué está en peligro. Una caída o fuga de datos cuesta mucho más.

glossary.meaning: Atajos del pasado en el código que hoy hacen lento y riesgoso cambiarlo.
Revisión completa del sistema con hallazgos y prioridades.

items.name: AI Adoption Training & Coaching
items.oneLiner: Hands-on training that teaches a company's team to use AI (Claude, ChatGPT, automations) on their real daily work — safely — so everyone saves hours every week starting from the first session.
items.description: Personalized AI training for companies and individuals. We map how the team works, then run live sessions using their own documents, emails and processes: writing, research, reports, customer replies, data analysis, meeting notes and simple automations. Includes a prompt library per role, an AI usage policy (what data can and cannot go into AI tools), 1:1 coaching for leaders and a 30-day follow-up measuring time saved. Formats: 1:1 coaching (hourly), team workshops (half day) and 4–8 week adoption programs.
deliverables: AI readiness assessment of the team's processes
Live workshops with the company's own cases
Prompt library and step-by-step guides per role
AI usage policy (data privacy and safe use)

idealCustomer.companySize: Any company with 3–300 employees, plus executives and professionals one-on-one
idealCustomer.description: Every business that runs on emails, documents, spreadsheets and customer conversations — which is nearly all of them. Best fit: owners who know AI matters but don't know where to start, and teams already using ChatGPT informally and unsafely.

buyingSignals: The owner or managers post about AI on LinkedIn or say they want to 'get into AI'
Job posts asking for 'AI skills', 'ChatGPT' or 'automation'
Heavy admin or document work (proposals, reports, emails, quotes)
Growing team that is hiring admin or assistant roles
No mention of AI tools or policies anywhere on the website
Competitors in their market are announcing AI use
disqualifiers: Tech companies with an in-house AI/ML team
One-person businesses with no budget for training
painPointsSolved: Hours lost every week on repetitive writing, research and reports
Staff pasting client data into public AI tools without rules
Owners who know AI matters but don't know where to start
Fear of falling behind competitors that already use AI

packages.name: 1:1 coaching
packages.detail: Owners, executives or professionals. Packs of 5–10 hours.

pricing.notes: Excelente entrada: después de la capacitación salen naturalmente oportunidades de automatización e IA a la medida (upsell).

items.roi: If 10 employees each save 3 hours a week at $25/hour, that's ~$39,000 a year in recovered time — the full program costs a fraction of that.

pitch.hook: Most {niche} teams are already using ChatGPT — without rules and without getting much out of it. We train your team to use AI on your real work, safely, so everyone saves hours every week starting from the first session.
valueProps: Trained on your own processes and documents, not generic theory
Clear AI usage policy to protect client data
Taught by engineers who build AI systems every day
pitch.proof: We can run a free 30-minute diagnostic with the owner and show 3 tasks AI can take off their plate this week.

objections.response: Great — most teams use 10% of what it can do, and often paste client data where they shouldn't. We make that usage systematic, safe and measurable.
That's exactly who it's for. No coding: we teach with their own emails, documents and tasks, step by step.

objections.objection: We don't have time for training.
objections.response: The first session is built to save time the same week. If it doesn't save more hours than it takes, we've done it wrong.
Part of the program is an AI usage policy: which tools, which settings and what data never goes in. Most companies don't have one and are exposed today.

salesGuide.simple: Clases personalizadas para que el equipo de una empresa (o una persona) aprenda a usar IA como Claude o ChatGPT en su trabajo real: redactar, investigar, hacer reportes, responder clientes y automatizar tareas simples. Se trabaja con los documentos y procesos de la empresa, no con teoría.
howItWorks: Diagnóstico: entrevistamos al dueño y revisamos qué tareas repite el equipo.
Diseñamos las sesiones por rol (ventas, administración, gerencia...).
Talleres en vivo con sus propios casos: cada persona sale con algo que ya le ahorra tiempo.
Entregamos una biblioteca de prompts, guías y una política de uso seguro de IA.
Seguimiento a 30 días: medimos horas ahorradas y detectamos qué se puede automatizar.
salesGuide.example: Una agencia de seguros de 12 personas tardaba 40 minutos en cada comparación de pólizas y en responder correos de clientes. Después de un programa de 4 semanas, el equipo usa IA para resumir pólizas y redactar respuestas, y ahorra 3–4 horas por persona a la semana. Además salió un proyecto de automatización de cotizaciones.
qualifyingQuestions: Is your team using ChatGPT or any AI tool today? How?
Which tasks eat most of your team's week (emails, reports, quotes, research)?
Do you have rules about what client data can go into AI tools?
How many people would we train?
salesGuide.priceTalk: Calcula horas: 10 personas × 3 horas a la semana × USD 25 = ~USD 39.000 al año. El programa completo cuesta una fracción. Para dudosos, empieza con un taller de medio día.
redFlags: Empresas de tecnología con equipo propio de IA.
Negocio de una persona sin presupuesto.
salesGuide.upsell: Es la mejor puerta de entrada: durante la capacitación aparecen procesos que conviene automatizar o un asistente de IA privado. Anótalos como oportunidades.

glossary.meaning: La instrucción que se le escribe a la IA.
Reglas de la empresa sobre qué herramientas y qué datos se pueden usar con IA.
